changelog.title: The Extraction
changelog.description: Catalog drift cleared. Modules that lived in shadow are now indexed, navigable, and accountable. The city's directory is complete.

changelog.title: Progress Integrity
changelog.description: Several courses now track per-module completion correctly. Student work is recognized as it should be. The records are honest.

changelog.title: The Sentinels
changelog.description: New automated checks run on every change. They watch for the patterns that bite when no one is looking. They do not blink.

changelog.title: The Construct
changelog.description: Eight per-house holding areas appear at the foot of each house. Content awaiting a permanent home is gathered there — visible, navigable, and clearly marked.

changelog.title: Three New Tracks
changelog.description: Database Fundamentals lights up in House of the Script. Bash Mastery follows. CMMC 2.0 takes its place in House of the Shield. Three more wings of the city, named and lit.

changelog.title: The Investigator's Wing
changelog.description: Digital Forensics moves into House of the Eye. Three certification paths — CHFI, GCFA, GCFE — go live with full module coverage. Old paths still work; new home is the destination.

changelog.title: Matrix Awakens
changelog.description: House of the Matrix declares itself. Advanced Linux Administration. Operator. Protocore. PiVerse. The training rooms are loaded. The construct is ready.

changelog.title: The Factionless Find a House
changelog.description: Divergent steps forward. Cybersecurity Ethics, Ethics in IT, Cybersecurity Policy — three full courses, one address. The unclassifiable now belong somewhere.

changelog.title: The Guardian
changelog.description: New safety layers stand between work-in-progress and production. Mistakes are caught earlier. Recovery is faster. The doors close more carefully now.
